snippet.title: Relocat Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Relocat launches on Steam on November 10, 2026!

Wishlist Relocat and play the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3944590/

A heartfelt New Year’s story about relocation and growing up. From wrapping gifts to navigating bureaucracy, can you adjust to a new life and discover what home means to you now?

-------------------

Inky the kitten is preparing for a quiet New Year celebration in his home village of Mora. But an announcement on New Year’s Eve changes everything. Ahead lie a train journey, an unfamiliar city, and an attempt to start over in a place where even the right to stay has to be proven.

Features:

• Meet all kinds of characters, each with their own stories and motives
• Discover new activities—from relaxing gift wrapping and cooking to competitive challenges
• Face paperwork, money, obligations, and other rules of the adult world
• Make difficult decisions that lead to multiple endings
• Play with keyboard and mouse or Xbox and PlayStation controllers
• Available in English and Russian

-------------------

Coming to Steam on November 10, 2026.
